parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: ID of your own user. `me` is also accepted for the signed-in user

code.description: A current TOTP code or an unused backup code

200.description: true when TOTP was turned off

description:
Turns TOTP off for your own account after a check of one current code. The backup codes are deleted when no other factor is left. 400 when TOTP is not on or the code is wrong.

Needs: a signed-in session as that user (API tokens are refused)
